main.toolTipHeader: Stretchly - The break time reminder app
main.warning: This will restore app defaults and all your settings will be lost.

settings.openAtLogin: Start Stretchly automatically when logging in
settings.monitorIdleTime: Monitor system idle time (breaks are paused if system is idle).
settings.monitorDnd: Show breaks even in Do Not Disturb mode

schedule.miniBreaksInfo: Mini breaks are short breaks taken regularly to give you a chance to stretch and relax.
schedule.showNotificationBeforeMiniBreak: Show notification before Mini break starts
schedule.longBreaksInfo: Long breaks are taken less regularly, but are of greater duration, allowing you to take an extended break from your work.
schedule.showNotificationBeforeLongBreak: Show notification before Long break starts
schedule.strictModeInfo: Strict mode prevents you from skipping either Mini breaks or Long breaks and is designed to help discipline.
schedule.enableStrictMini: Enable Strict mode for Mini breaks
schedule.enableStrictLong: Enable Strict mode for Long breaks
schedule.cantDisableBoth: It is not possible to disable both types of breaks

about.learnMore: To learn more about Stretchly features, view a tutorial, download the latest version or contact us for support,
about.designedBy: Icon and UI design by Colin Shanley

heart.desc1: Taking regular breaks when using a computer is scientifically proven to be important for your physical and mental well-being.
heart.desc2: Stretchly is free. But you can lend your support by donating and help us continue to improve Stretchly and release other free software.

contributorPreferences.title: Contributor Preferences
contributorPreferences.notificationsInfo: System notification shown before breaks to let you prepare for it.
contributorPreferences.newVersionNotification: Notify when new version is available
contributorPreferences.customIdeasInfo: Allows you to use custom break ideas by editing configuration file. (For advanced users.)
contributorPreferences.useIdeasFromSettings: Use break ideas from configuration file
contributorPreferences.breakPostponeInfo: If enabled in main Preferences, you can postpone breaks. Following settings allow you to specify when, for how long and how many times you can postpone a break.
contributorPreferences.pauseUntilMorningInfo: Specify till what hour 'Pause until morning' should pause.
contributorPreferences.showWelcomeWindow: Show Welcome window on next start
contributorPreferences.opacityInfo: How solid should the break window be?
contributorPreferences.breakWindowSizeInfo: What percentage of the screen should the break window hide?
contributorPreferences.miniBreakStartSound: Sound at the start of Mini break
contributorPreferences.longBreakStartSound: Sound at the start of Long break
contributorPreferences.naturalBreaksInfo: If monitoring of idle time is enabled in main Preferences, you can specify after what time the breaks should be paused.
contributorPreferences.showBreaksAsRegularWindowsInfo: When enabled, break windows will become focusable, they won't be 'Always on top' anymore and they will also appear in the taskbar.
contributorPreferences.screenInfo: When showing breaks on all monitors is disabled, you can choose which one you would like to show your breaks on.
contributorPreferences.showCurrentTimeInBreaks: Show current local time in break window

aaa.title: Refill your water
aaa.text: Walk to the kitchen, fill a glass, and take three slow sips before you sit down.

aab.title: Look left and right
aab.text: Keep your head still. Move only your eyes fully left, then fully right, five times.

aac.title: Look up and down
aac.text: Keep your head still. Look up to the top edge of the screen, then down to the keyboard, five times.

aad.title: Take three breaths
aad.text: Close your eyes and breathe in for 4 seconds, hold for 2, then breathe out for 6.

aae.title: Rest your eyes
aae.text: Close your eyes, relax your jaw, and let your shoulders drop for 20 seconds.

aaf.title: Straighten your legs
aaf.text: Push your chair back, extend both legs, flex your toes toward you, and hold for 15 seconds.

aag.title: Reach overhead
aag.text: Interlace your fingers, turn palms upward, and reach toward the ceiling for 15 seconds.

aah.title: Reset your posture
aah.text: Put both feet flat, move your hips to the back of the chair, and lower your shoulders.

aai.title: Turn your neck
aai.text: Turn your head slowly to the left, hold for 8 seconds, then repeat to the right.

aaj.title: Tilt your neck
aaj.text: Tilt your right ear toward your right shoulder for 8 seconds, then switch sides.

aak.title: Stand and lengthen
aak.text: Stand up, lift your chest, and reach both hands behind your back for one breath.

aal.title: Focus far away
aal.text: Look at the farthest object you can see and keep your gaze there for 20 seconds.

aam.title: Name one good thing
aam.text: Think of one specific thing that went well today, even if it was small.

aan.title: Soften your face
aan.text: Unclench your jaw, relax your eyebrows, and make a small smile for 10 seconds.

aao.title: Move away from the desk
aao.text: Roll your chair back until your hands leave the keyboard, then rest there for 20 seconds.

aap.title: Count five breaths
aap.text: Close your eyes and count five natural breaths without changing the pace.

aaq.title: Listen for three sounds
aaq.text: Close your eyes and identify three separate sounds in the room or outside.

aar.title: Roll your shoulders
aar.text: Place fingertips on shoulders. Roll forward for 10 seconds, then backward for 10.

aas.title: Reach to each side
aas.text: Raise your right arm overhead and lean left for 10 seconds, then switch sides.

aat.title: Squeeze each finger
aat.text: Use one hand to gently squeeze each finger of the other hand from base to tip.

aau.title: Take one lunge
aau.text: Stand up, step one foot back, bend both knees slightly, hold for 8 seconds, then switch.

aav.title: Notice the moment
aav.text: Pause and name one body sensation, one thought, and one emotion without judging them.

aaw.title: Use the 20-20 rule
aaw.text: Look at something about 6 meters away for 20 seconds before returning to the screen.

aax.title: Ask for one thing
aax.text: If you are blocked, write the one question you need answered next.

aay.title: Pick one task
aay.text: Choose the next single action you will do after this break and ignore the rest for now.

aaz.title: Check your attention
aaz.text: Name what currently has your attention and decide whether to keep it there.

aba.title: Change seat position
aba.text: Shift your hips, adjust your chair height if needed, and place both feet flat again.

abb.title: Find natural light
abb.text: Look toward a window or a bright wall and let your eyes rest there for 15 seconds.

abc.title: Move closed eyes up and down
abc.text: Close your eyes, slowly look upward, then downward, six times.

abd.title: Move closed eyes left and right
abd.text: Close your eyes, slowly look left, then right, six times.

abe.title: Shake out your hands
abe.text: Let your arms hang loose and shake your hands for 10 seconds.

abf.title: Touch thumb to fingers
abf.text: Touch thumb to each fingertip one by one, then reverse the order.

abg.title: Open your hands
abg.text: Make a fist, then open your fingers wide like a stop sign. Repeat 8 times.

abh.title: Fan your fingers
abh.text: Make a loose fist, then spread your fingers as wide as possible. Repeat 8 times.

abi.title: Draw a slow neck circle
abi.text: Sit tall and draw one slow circle with your nose. Reverse direction once.

abj.title: Stretch neck to shoulder
abj.text: Use your right hand to guide your head gently toward the right shoulder, then switch.

abk.title: Squeeze shoulder blades
abk.text: Pull your shoulder blades together, hold for 5 seconds, release, and repeat 5 times.

abl.title: Open your chest
abl.text: Raise arms to shoulder height, move hands slightly behind you, hold one breath, return.

abm.title: Twist in your chair
abm.text: Sit at the chair edge, rotate your torso to the right for 10 seconds, then left.

abn.title: Prop one foot up
abn.text: Put one heel on a low object, keep the knee soft, and lean forward slightly.

abo.title: Do chair squats
abo.text: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, sit back toward the chair, then stand. Repeat 5 times.

abp.title: Slide arms on the wall
abp.text: Stand with your back to a wall and slowly slide both arms up and down 5 times.

abq.title: Do wall push-ups
abq.text: Place hands on a wall and do 8 slow push-ups, keeping your body straight.

abr.title: Extend one leg
abr.text: Sit at the chair edge, straighten one leg for 10 seconds, then switch.

abs.title: Stretch your calves
abs.text: Face a wall, step one foot back, press the heel down, then switch sides.

abt.title: Stretch the back of your arm
abt.text: Lift one arm, bend the elbow, and gently guide it behind your head, then switch.

abu.title: Nod and tilt gently
abu.text: Slowly tilt your head left, right, forward, and back. Keep each movement small.

abv.title: Cross-body shoulder stretch
abv.text: Bring one arm across your chest and hold it with the other arm for 10 seconds.

abw.title: Reach toward toes
abw.text: Put one foot on a low object and reach toward your toes without forcing the stretch.

abx.title: Use the doorway
abx.text: Place forearms on both sides of a doorway and lean forward until your chest opens.

aby.title: Stretch inner thighs
aby.text: Sit with soles together and gently press your knees downward with your elbows.

aaa.title: Take a real walk
aaa.text: Leave the desk and walk one full loop outside the room. Do not bring the phone unless you need it for safety.

aab.title: Let a problem cool
aab.text: Write the problem in one sentence, step away for two minutes, then return and write the next action.

aac.title: Create desk distance
aac.text: Move at least three meters away from the computer and keep both hands off devices for one minute.

aad.title: Do one mindful minute
aad.text: Settle your feet, breathe normally, and notice breath, posture, and sound for one minute.

aae.title: Refresh your eyes
aae.text: Blink quickly for 10 seconds, then look far away for 30 seconds.

aaf.title: Check desk height
aaf.text: Set elbows near 90 degrees, lower your shoulders, and bring the screen top near eye level.

aag.title: March in place
aag.text: Stand and march in place for one minute. Lift knees only as high as feels comfortable.

aah.title: Change work mode
aah.text: If you can, raise the desk or move to a standing spot for the next work block.

aai.title: Read your focus signal
aai.text: If you were rereading the same line, write down the distraction and choose one next task.

aaj.title: Take a no-screen lap
aaj.text: Walk for two minutes without reading messages, notifications, or another screen.

aak.title: Restart circulation
aak.text: Walk, climb one flight of stairs, or do calf raises for two minutes.

aal.title: Move one conversation
aal.text: If a short conversation is pending, handle it while standing or walking.

aam.title: Eat one thing slowly
aam.text: If you have fruit or a snack, take three slow bites and notice texture before returning.

aan.title: Choose the farther route
aan.text: Use the restroom, printer, or water source that makes you walk farther.

aao.title: Add five minutes to coffee
aao.text: If you are getting coffee or tea, add a five-minute walk before the first sip.

aap.title: Walk before messaging
aap.text: For one nearby person, talk in person instead of sending a message.

aaq.title: Consolidate learning
aaq.text: After learning something new, look away and summarize it in one sentence from memory.

aar.title: Do a small exercise set
aar.text: Pick one: 10 wall push-ups, 10 squats, or 30 seconds of marching.

aas.title: Repeat the useful stretch
aas.text: Choose the stretch that helped most today and repeat it twice slowly.

aat.title: Reset wrists and forearms
aat.text: Extend arms, rotate wrists four times clockwise and four times counter-clockwise.

aau.title: Lengthen your back
aau.text: Interlace hands behind your head, lift elbows slightly, and breathe into your ribs.

aav.title: Move for one minute
aav.text: For the next minute, keep moving: walk, step, stretch, or tidy something nearby.

aaw.title: Start a short workout
aaw.text: Open a short workout timer and complete only the first round if time is limited.

aax.title: Raise your pulse gently
aax.text: Climb stairs or walk briskly until your breathing is slightly faster, then slow down.

aay.title: Use one staircase
aay.text: Take one flight of stairs up or down, then walk back at an easy pace.

aaz.title: Make a tiny sketch
aaz.text: Draw one object on your desk in 60 seconds. Accuracy does not matter.

aba.title: Clear one surface
aba.text: Remove five items from your desk or put them where they belong.

abb.title: Step into daylight
abb.text: If daylight is available, stand near it or go outside for two minutes.

abc.title: Plan one active errand
abc.text: Choose one later errand where you can stand, walk, bike, or take the longer path.

abd.title: Let yourself yawn
abd.text: Relax your jaw and take a wide, slow yawn to moisten your eyes and face.

abe.title: Shift near and far
abe.text: Focus on one finger near your face, then an object far away. Repeat 5 times.

abf.title: Squeeze and release
abf.text: Squeeze a soft object or rolled cloth for 5 seconds, release, and repeat 8 times.

abg.title: Slow the exhale
abg.text: Breathe in naturally, then make each exhale a little longer for one minute.

abh.title: Picture a calm place
abh.text: Close your eyes and imagine one calm place with three concrete details.

abi.title: Use 5-4-3-2-1
abi.text: Name 5 things you see, 4 you feel, 3 you hear, 2 you smell, and 1 you taste.

abj.title: Cover your eyes
abj.text: Cup your palms over closed eyes, keep pressure off the eyelids, and breathe slowly.
